records.context: : AREA: player_instructions; NOTE: player role hint text, Segundo Volante is ID 438384
records.template_english: The 'Segundo Volante' is different from the Deep-Lying Playmaker in that their role is primarily a defensive one best suited to being paired with an Anchor, and is also different from the Ball-Winning Midfielder, in that they often run with the ball, or arrive with a late run, into the opposition area in much the same way a Box-to-Box Central Midfielder does.
en: The 'Segundo Volante' is different from the Deep-Lying Playmaker in that their role is primarily a defensive one best suited to being paired with an Anchor, and is also different from the Ball-Winning Midfielder, in that they often run with the ball, or arrive with a late run, into the opposition area in much the same way a Box-to-Box Central Midfielder does.
es: El 'Segundo volante' es distinto al organizador retrasado, ya que su rol es básicamente defensivo, y funciona mejor si se lo empareja con un organizador defensivo. También es distinto al mediocampista recuperador, porque generalmente aguantan el balón o llegan arriba desde atrás al área rival casi como hace un mediocampista todoterreno.

records.context: : AREA: player_instructions; NOTE: player role hint text
records.template_english:
A Complete Forward possesses all the technical attributes of a Deep-Lying Forward, the goal scoring ability of a Poacher and the strength and power of a Target Forward.

Equally adept at playing in others, fashioning chances and getting on the end of team moves, such a player transcends tactical instruction and should simply be allowed to do their own thing.
en:
A Complete Forward possesses all the technical attributes of a Deep-Lying Forward, the goal scoring ability of a Poacher and the strength and power of a Target Forward.

Equally adept at playing in others, fashioning chances and getting on the end of team moves, such a player transcends tactical instruction and should simply be allowed to do their own thing.
es:
Un delantero completo tiene los atributos técnicos de un segundo delantero, la capacidad goleadora de un ariete y la fuerza y potencia de un delantero objetivo.

Se adapta por igual a jugar para otros, generar ocasiones increíbles de gol o rematar las jugadas de equipo. Jugadores así están por encima de las instrucciones tácticas, por lo que simplemente hay que dejarlos hacer lo que quieran.

records.context: : AREA: player_instructions; NOTE: player role hint text
records.template_english:
Sometimes referred to as the 'Water Carrier', the Anchor's main duty is to sit in the hole between the defence and the midfield, intercepting moves, winning the ball and laying off simple passes to more creative teammates.

Since the key job is to anchor the defence, the Anchor doesn't venture too far from their position either to close down the opposition or to support the more advanced players.
en:
Sometimes referred to as the 'Water Carrier', the Anchor's main duty is to sit in the hole between the defence and the midfield, intercepting moves, winning the ball and laying off simple passes to more creative teammates.

Since the key job is to anchor the defence, the Anchor doesn't venture too far from their position either to close down the opposition or to support the more advanced players.
es:
A veces conocido como 'tapón', la tarea principal del organizador defensivo es la de situarse entre la defensa y el mediocampo para tapar desmarques, robar el balón y dar pases sencillos a sus compañeros más creativos.

Como su tarea es básicamente la de ayudar a la defensa, no se suele aventurar a moverse mucho de su posición, ni tampoco suele presionar al rival o apoyar a sus compañeros más ofensivos.

records.context: : AREA: player_instructions; NOTE: player role hint text
records.template_english: The Wide Target Forward will be the main outlet for clearances and long balls from the back. Ideally positioned against a smaller and weaker full-back, they will be asked to get hold of the ball and keep it before recycling it to a team-mate.
en: The Wide Target Forward will be the main outlet for clearances and long balls from the back. Ideally positioned against a smaller and weaker full-back, they will be asked to get hold of the ball and keep it before recycling it to a team-mate.
es: El delantero objetivo escorado será la principal opción para los despejes y balones largos desde la defensa. Lo mejor es colocarlo ante un lateral más pequeño y débil para que consiga el balón y lo mantenga hasta poder distribuirlo a algún compañero.

records.template_english:
As a Wide Outlet, the Winger is asked to avoid tracking back to help out the Full-Back behind them as much, instead looking to hold their position more in order to be in a dangerous position for a counter-attack when the ball turns over. 
Because they don't do as much defensive work, it's often important to ensure that the team aren't exposed on their flank e.g. by asking nearby midfielders to play a Wide Cover role to cover for them.
en: As a Wide Outlet, the Winger is asked to avoid tracking back to help out the Full-Back behind them as much, instead looking to hold their position more in order to be in a dangerous position for a counter-attack when the ball turns over.

The first job of the Advanced Centre-Back is to provide protection to the team, being in a position where they can be ready to react to attacking threats when the ball is turned over. 
However the Advanced Centre-Back is also a specialist role, acting as a central defender during deep build-up before then moving forward into a defensive midfield position as their team progresses play up the pitch. Because of this, the role requires exceptional technical and mental skills that you'd typically expect of a midfield player. 
Elsewhere in defence, it's important to ensure the team has sufficient coverage at centre-back, typically through the use of an Inverted Full-Back.

A defensive midfielder who looks to drop into their team's defensive line as they progress the ball up the pitch, the Half-Back acts as an additional central defender. 
They are typically used by teams with two central defenders in their in-possession formation so as to ensure that they have three players at the back in the event that the opposition starts a counter-attack. This can also make the team more press-resistant, particularly against teams that press with a front two. 
When used centrally, the Half Back will drop between their team's central defenders. However, when used in side defensive midfield positions, the Half Back will drop to one side of their central defenders as either a RCB or LCB.
en: A defensive midfielder who looks to drop into their team's defensive line as they progress the ball up the pitch, the Half-Back acts as an additional central defender.

The non-stop dynamism of the Box-to-Box Midfielder enables them to contribute greatly to both attacking play during the build-up and in the final third. 
During build-up, they are positioned as a traditional defensive midfield player, offering passing options to help progress the play forward. During the latter phases of attack, they surge towards the final third in order to operate more like an attacking midfielder, arriving into the box to get on the end of crosses and pullbacks, as well as providing a threat from the edge of the box. 
Because of the amount ground they are asked to cover on the pitch, the role requires very high work rate and energy levels.

A player with a Free Role is given full creative license, allowing them to roam from their position to create attacking opportunities for their team whilst also being encouraged to take more risks with the ball in an effort to both create and score goals. 
Because of the freedom they're allowed, the Free Role is less likely to follow the team's explicit instructions and may break the team's structure at times. However, their unpredictability and creativity can help to unlock defences for their team.
en: A player with a Free Role is given full creative license, allowing them to roam from their position to create attacking opportunities for their team whilst also being encouraged to take more risks with the ball in an effort to both create and score goals.
es: Un jugador con libertad de movimientos tiene licencia creativa total, lo que le permite moverse con libertad desde su posición original para generar oportunidades ofensivas para su equipo. Se le anima a asumir más riesgos con el balón, tanto para crear como para finalizar jugadas.

records.template_english:
The Second Striker operates as one of the team's main goalscoring threats. 
In early phases of attack, the Second Striker positions themselves between the opposition midfield and defence in pockets of space. However, as play progresses up the pitch, they aggressively push up into the forward line in order to get into goalscoring positions as the ball moves into the final third. 
As the name implies, the Second Striker is most commonly utilised in formations with a lone forward.
en: The Second Striker operates as one of the team's main goalscoring threats.
es: El segundo delantero actúa como una de las principales amenazas ofensivas del equipo.

records.template_english:
The Inside Forward is a wide role that aims to frequently drift inside into the half-spaces as their team attacks to help open up space for overlapping full-backs, as well as being in position to receive the ball in more central areas of the pitch. 
As with the Wide Forward, the Inside Forward is also primarily an offensive role in the final third. focused on attacking the opposition's penalty box and making dangerous runs behind their defence in order to get into goalscoring positions. 
The role works best when combined with an attacking full-back or wing-back that looks to hug the sideline.
en: The Inside Forward is a wide role that aims to frequently drift inside into the half-spaces as their team attacks to help open up space for overlapping full-backs, as well as being in position to receive the ball in more central areas of the pitch.

A high-energy role, the Channel Forward looks to constantly be a thorn in opposition defenders' sides, regularly making supporting runs into the channels for their team.

records.template_english:
An unconventional centre forward, the False Nine regularly drops between the lines of the opposition's defence and midfield, looking to act similarly to an Advanced Playmaker for their team. 
The purpose of this is that it creates a tactical problem for opposing central defenders who can either choose to follow them (leaving space in behind) or leave them to have time and space to dribble or pick out a pass. 
Because of these movements it's often important to pair a False Nine with teammates who regularly look to make runs into goalscoring positions, such as a Second Striker, Inside Forward or Wide Forward.
en: An unconventional centre forward, the False Nine regularly drops between the lines of the opposition's defence and midfield, looking to act similarly to an Advanced Playmaker for their team.
es: Un delantero centro poco convencional, el Falso Nueve suele estar entre las líneas de la defensa y el mediocampo del equipo rival, buscando actuar de manera similar a un Organizador avanzado para su equipo.

The Poacher sits on the shoulder of the last defender, looking to break the defensive line and run onto through balls from midfield. 
Requiring excellent off the ball movement to be effective in the role, the Poacher is expected to be the team's main source of goals. Their focus on scoring goals is so extreme that they rarely offer much help in constructing moves or linking play, instead remaining in central areas, sniffing out opportunities in and around the box.
en: The Poacher sits on the shoulder of the last defender, looking to break the defensive line and run onto through balls from midfield.

The non-stop dynamism of the Box-to-Box Midfielder enables them to contribute greatly to both build-up and final-third attacking play.

During build-up they position as a traditional defensive midfield player, offering passing options to help progress the play forwards. The False Nine is an unconventional centre - forward who regularly drops between the lines, looking to act similarly to an Advanced Playmaker for their team.

The purpose of this is that it creates a problem for opposing central defenders who can either follow them - leaving space behind them for onrushing midfielders, forwards or wingers to exploit - or leave them to have time and space to dribble or pick out a pass.

Because of these movements it's often important to pair a False Nine with teammates who regularly look to make runs into goalscoring positions, such as a Second Striker, Half-Space Forward or Wide Forward.

records.template_english:
The first job of the Advanced Centre-Back is to provide protection to the team, being in a position where they can be ready to react to attacking threats when the ball is turned over. 
However the Advanced Centre-Back is also a specialist role, acting as a central defender during deep build-up before then moving forward into a defensive midfield position as their team progresses play up the pitch. Because of this, the role requires exceptional technical and mental skills that you'd typically expect of a midfield player. 
Elsewhere in defence, it's important to ensure the team has sufficient coverage at centre-back, typically through the use of an Inverted Full-Back.
